our_interpretation: The plain reading is that substantial, unintended invention of purported facts is unusual in humans outside the stated clinical exception, but is a recurring failure of contemporary LLMs.

Wholesale fabrication means inventing an event, entity, source, or substantial factual account. Ordinary inaccuracies, mistaken arguments, deliberate lies, jokes, and requested fiction do not establish it.
Rarely is qualitative. I do not impose a numerical threshold or read the claim as saying that healthy humans never fabricate.

The target is the state of knowledge and the LLMs existing as of the post. This subject has no quarterly or annual reporting cycle. The period therefore ends on the post date and has no invented start date; it is not restricted to calendar 2023.
A fair comparison requires sufficiently comparable opportunities and definitions, whether supplied by a direct experiment or by compatible bodies of research.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence establishes both that contemporary LLMs recurrently invent substantial purported facts and that comparable unintended invention is unusual among humans outside the stated clinical exception.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Representative evidence shows that comparable wholesale invention is common among those humans, or that the asserted qualitative contrast with contemporary LLMs does not hold. Isolated human examples do not contradict rarely.

evidence.explanation: The study examined 636 citations across 84 generated literature reviews and distinguished nonexistent works from inaccurate citations to real works. It supports the LLM portion of the claim, but contains no matched human fabrication rate.

evidence.excerpt: more limited than has been suggested.
evidence.publisher: Applied Cognitive Psychology; copy hosted by UCL Discovery
evidence.explanation: The review reports that suggestion can elicit recollective experiences of nonexistent events, with about 15% of participants meeting its fuller-memory standard. This is relevant counterevidence to an absolute human–LLM distinction, but induced childhood memories do not measure everyday fabrication or directly contradict rarely.

TruthfulQA supplies a human–model comparison, but tests responses to questions designed around false beliefs and misconceptions. Its truthfulness scores and limited human baseline do not establish the prevalence of wholesale unintentional invention.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Comparable measurements, or a defensible synthesis of existing measurements, separating substantial unintended invention from ordinary errors in nonclinical humans and models available by the post date.
